scope_note: Four broad query envelopes cover the main island and offshore archipelagos. They include ocean and may include land outside the intended administrative scope. They do not assert sovereignty, a maritime claim, or an exhaustive island inventory. Named windows are display/validation samples, not land masks. No territorial boundary is inferred.

coverage.denominator: all cells in this rectangular geographic query window; includes sea and sometimes other jurisdictions; not provincial land completeness
coverage.cloud_note: not applicable: this environmental product has no cloud class

records.preview_note: Zero-height cells are transparent in preview (usually ocean); numerical grid preserves source zero. Not a coastline or verified land mask.
records.native_resolution: 1 arcsecond (~30 m latitude); source DSM, not bare-earth terrain
records.period: TanDEM-X mainly 2011–2015; infill can be older; catalog 2021 publication is not observation date
